name: QR Code for OTP Setup
summary: Generate otpauth:// QR codes for TOTP authenticator app setup — local and educational.
description: Build a standard otpauth:// TOTP URI from issuer, account, and Base32 secret, then render a QR code for Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy. Generate new secrets locally — nothing is stored on a server.

faqs.question: Is this for production 2FA?
faqs.answer: Use only with secrets you control. This is an educational setup helper — verify URIs before scanning.

faqs.question: What secret format is required?
faqs.answer: Base32 (A–Z, 2–7), typically 16+ characters as provided by your identity provider.
